english.note: Use this when an official person or organization makes information public, especially a decision, result, or policy.

exampleSentences.english: The committee will proclaim the results of this year's competition.
exampleSentences.traditional: 大會公布今屆比賽結果。
exampleSentences.jyutping: daai6 wui6 gung1 bou3 gam1 gaai3 bei2 coi3 git3 gwo2

english.note: Use this when an organization or person announces information or results publicly.

exampleSentences.english: The organizers will post the competition results next week.
exampleSentences.traditional: 大會下星期公布比賽結果。
exampleSentences.jyutping: daai6 wui6 haa6 sing1 kei4 gung1 bou3 bei2 coi3 git3 gwo2

english.note: Use 公布 for officially making information, decisions, or notices public rather than issuing a publication.

exampleSentences.english: The government will publish the investigation results tomorrow.
exampleSentences.traditional: 政府聽日會公布調查結果。
exampleSentences.jyutping: zing3 fu2 ting1 jat6 wui5 gung1 bou3 tiu4 caa4 git3 gwo2
